$comment: Tier aliases plus the permission reviewer's chain; every entry is a concrete model, since aliases cannot nest. Rung order is ADR-0103's (capability, then turn completion here, then agentic evidence, then price); one Go rung per tier (ADR-0125). No prices, caps or scores here — `bin/pi-model-cost` prints them (ADR-0118). Scores read 2026-11-23: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0.1. Quota 402/429 is not unavailability (ADR-0131); unscored free-pool trials are benched with evidence (ADR-0132). Rejected candidates live in `$bench`: why each is out and what would promote it.

opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor.out: stalls mid-turn here (output stops, user says continue), so turn completion fails
opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor.promote: a later revision streams reliably to completion in this harness

opencode-go/hy4.out: scores above glm-5.3 but burns several times as fast and carries a smaller cap, so it can neither lead nor sit behind it
opencode-go/hy4.promote: top needs another rung from the same pool and that burn is accepted

opencode-go/gemini-4-argon.out: the cheapest route to top-class capability, blocked by a cap that a handful of hard turns spends
opencode-go/gemini-4-argon.promote: top turns need what glm-5.3 cannot give and the pool cost is accepted

opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro.out: below glm-5.3 on both the agentic evaluations and the composite, on a smaller cap
opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro.promote: its terms improve or the tier it would serve drops below it

opencode-go/kimi-k2.7-code.out: no composite, and it fails Terminal-Bench 4.0 outright while promising on other evals
opencode-go/kimi-k2.7-code.promote: AA scores it, and its Terminal-Bench 4.0 result proves to be a harness artefact rather than a capability signal

opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-pro.out: a documented tool-call repetition failure mode keeps it below every rung with a clean record
opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-pro.promote: the failure mode is fixed in a later revision

opencode-go/glm-5.3-flash.out: the same family as glm-5.3 with less capability and no larger cap, so it never outlives it
opencode-go/glm-5.3-flash.promote: glm-5.3's cap or price changes enough to separate them

opencode-go/minimax-m3.1-flash.out: cheaper per token than the rungs above it but with the smallest cap in the pool, so it locks out first
opencode-go/minimax-m3.1-flash.promote: the pool's leaders cap out and this one's cap rises

claude-bridge/claude-fable-5-2.out: the highest score the harness can reach, blocked by sharing one five-hour window with every tier, which mid needs first
claude-bridge/claude-fable-5-2.promote: a window of its own appears, or mid stops leading with sonnet-5-5

opencode-go/iceman-contributor-free.out: free and answering here, including a bounded tool loop, but unscored and without comparative evidence over hy4-flash-free; text-only, training-eligible and not zero-retention
opencode-go/iceman-contributor-free.promote: a comparable score or repeated harness evidence beats the current free tail and the training tradeoff is accepted

opencode-go/muse-spark-1.2-contributor.out: training-class contributor without a comparable composite; its coding component is far below the placed rungs
opencode-go/muse-spark-1.2-contributor.promote: a comparable score or agentic evidence beats the current rung and the training tradeoff is accepted

opencode-go/hy3.out: no comparable composite and a very weak terminal benchmark component
opencode-go/hy3.promote: a scored release or harness evidence beats the current free or paid tail

opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash.out: no comparable composite or terminal benchmark components
opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash.promote: a scored release or measured agentic evidence beats the current rung

opencode-go/qwen3.7-plus.promote: a scored release or measured agentic evidence beats the current rung

opencode-go/hy4-preview.promote: a stable scored release beats the current rung
